The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] was '''annexed''' by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Wilek Nereus]] was installed as the planetary ruler over the [[Bakuran Senate]].
